- Vim (version: ) behaves differently?
Don't know
- Operating system/version:
Arch Linux x86-64
- Terminal name/version:
Terminix 1.3.0 and Neovim-QT v0.2.2.r27.g4015d8c-1
- `$TERM`: xterm-256color

### Actual behaviour

Neovim has been randomly crashing the last couple of days; I'll leave my computer unattended to get a cup of tea and neovim-qt will tell me that the nvim process has crashed, or I'll have a crash on the terminal. ### Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC`
I can't reproduce it because it happens infrequently and I don't really know what the trigger is. The error message says something to do with the yankring plugin and the clipboard (it was cleared before I could note it down), so I've removed that plugin and I'll update this bug report if that solves the issue.
